integrity: The proof derives every arc from the Frobenius fixed-point-free action and the abelianity of the kernel and complement. It proves that the relevant commutator endomorphism of the kernel is bijective, so eventual Engel vanishing outside the commuting case is impossible. The packaged replay independently enumerates all directed Engel relations and strong components in six semidirect products.
scientific_limitations: The Frobenius kernel is assumed abelian.
The Frobenius complement is assumed cyclic.
The result classifies this broad Frobenius family, not arbitrary Frobenius groups.
Equivalent formulations under different Engel-arrow conventions require reversing all arcs.
title: Engel digraphs of abelian-kernel cyclic Frobenius groups
